findings.title: AGENTS.md (the repository-root agent entry point) does not reference the machine-contract surface — a fresh coding agent cannot discover docs/developer/machine/** from the canonical entry
findings.reproduction: read AGENTS.md top to bottom: it is the INTERNAL program contract (the architect/Tech Lead/implementer recovery sequence — AI_CONTINUATION.md, docs/LLM-*, spec/*); grep -n 'docs/developer\|machine/' AGENTS.md → no matches; README.md equally carries no developer-kit entry (the DEP-041 F1 merge note, still open); the persona reaches the machine manifests only by repository directory exploration
findings.disposition: MERGE NOTE (AGENTS.md and README.md are outside this order's fix surface docs/developer/machine/**): add a machine-contract entry ('Integrating Zeck as a coding agent? The machine contract lives at docs/developer/machine/ — start with integration-recipe.json') to AGENTS.md's head and/or the README

findings.title: openapi.json omitted the required x-zeck-application parameter on POST /credentials/{credentialId}/rotate and /revoke — a request built exactly from the documented parameters was refused 422
findings.reproduction: POST /credentials/{id}/rotate with EXACTLY the documented parameters (IdempotencyKey, CredentialId) + bearer + empty body → 422 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE 'credential commands require the X-Zeck-Application header' (src/api/routes/credentials.ts: applicationScopeOf(request, 'credential commands')); POST /executions/{id}/cancel and POST /sandbox/identities/{id}/reset DO declare the ZeckApplication parameter — the same-document inconsistency a machine agent cannot resolve without guessing an undocumented header
findings.disposition: FIXED in docs/developer/machine/openapi.json (the ZeckApplication parameter ref added to both routes). Pin: the verification journey drive's step 3.7 passes (fail-before 422 recorded in the baseline drive's step 3.7); the machine-schemas openapi reconciliation battery stays green.
